rows.proof: TOWN OF LUNENBURG DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE AS OF JUNE 30, 2018, PER ISSUE -- pages 48 and 50 of the FY2018 annual town report, with the two MEADOW WOODS issues the same schedule prints on pages 49 and 51. SIXTEEN DEBT ISSUES against fiscal years 2019 to 2047 and 229 issue-years, each in up to four rows: PRINCIPAL, INTEREST, ADMIN FEE and the issue's own TOTAL. Six of the sixteen print no ADMIN FEE row at all; that is recorded as absent, not as zero. PAGE 50 WAS NOT IN THE PAGE TRACKER AT ALL, and it is the half of this table that makes it checkable: it carries FY2036 to FY2047 and, at its right-hand edge, a printed TOTAL for EVERY ISSUE. A page enters the tracker on fifteen recognised money figures; recognition found ONE word on page 50 -- the folio -- because it is a photograph, so the page was listed nowhere and the schedule was reported as the per-issue detail nobody had read. HOW IT WAS READ: pages 48 and 50 are PHOTOGRAPHS printed sideways and were read off their OWN EMBEDDED BITMAPS at native resolution, rotated upright and magnified -- no render scale adds detail a 110 dpi scan does not hold. Page 49 carries its own text layer and was read with pdfplumber; page 51 is a 287 dpi photograph and was read from the rendered image. No recognition was used anywhere. WHAT PROVES IT, three independent ways. (1) 229 ROW IDENTITIES, principal + interest + admin fee = the issue's own printed TOTAL: all 229 close within $1.00 and most exactly. (2) THE 50 PER-ISSUE TOTALS PAGE 50 PRINTS, each against that issue's own years: every one closes within $8, and the eight largest residuals all sit on issues whose interest carries cents across up to 27 displayed years. (3) THE ISSUES RECONCILE YEAR BY YEAR TO THE GRAND TOTAL ROWS ON PAGES 49 AND 51, which were proven separately against the TOTAL column page 51 prints: in all 29 years, principal, interest, MWPAT admin fees and TOTAL DEBT each match to within $2 -- 116 assertions that no misread anywhere could survive -- with ONE exception, below. The schedule prints WHOLE DOLLARS over amounts carrying cents, so a printed total is the rounded sum and not the sum of the rounded parts; the $20.00 tolerance declared on the aggregate columns is for that and nothing else, against 229 displayed issue-years, and the measured residuals on the columns it covers are -2 on principal and +7 on admin fee. THE ONE RESIDUAL THAT IS NOT ROUNDING IS ATTESTED: in FY2019 the issues' interest exceeds the printed GRAND TOTAL INTEREST by 272, and TOTAL DEBT by the same 272, in a year where principal ties EXACTLY. 272 is precisely the FY2019 interest of MASS WATER POOL 4*, an issue whose own row closes to the dollar (10,409 + 272 = 10,681) and whose 10,409 of principal IS in the grand total. So the town's own FY2019 grand total includes that issue's principal and excludes its interest. WHICH FIGURE IS WRONG IS NOT ESTABLISHED: the issue row and the grand total row cannot both be right and nothing in the document says which. This is not a tolerance -- the aggregate interest and total columns are excluded from the column check and named here instead -- and every other year's interest is within $1. TWO GRAINS OF ONE SCHEDULE, NEVER TO BE ADDED TOGETHER: this file is the PER-ISSUE grain and `fy2018-p49-debt-schedule.csv` is the PER-YEAR grain. The Meadow Woods figures appear in both, because the schedule prints them both as issues of itself and as rows of the year summary. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: nothing here says what the town BORROWED FOR beyond the issue names it prints, and an issue name is not a project.

rows.proof: LUNENBURG PUBLIC ACCESS CORPORATION (PAC), `FY 18 Expenses` and `FY18 REVENUE vs EXPENSES` -- pages 82 and 83 of the FY2018 annual town report, inside the Public Access Corporation's own report. NEITHER PAGE WAS IN THE PAGE TRACKER: page 82 carries ten money figures and page 83 carries five, and a page enters the tracker only on fifteen, so the only statement of what the town's cable PEG money took in and paid out in FY2018 was listed nowhere. Both pages carry their OWN TEXT LAYER and were read with pdfplumber; no recognition was used. WHAT PROVES IT: two identities the pages state about themselves, both exact to the cent. The ten expense lines sum to the printed `TOTAL $90,582.67` on page 82; and on page 83 Starting Balance 303,551.54 + Revenue 111,045.25 = the printed Subtotal 414,596.79, and that less the same Expenses 90,582.67 = the printed Ending Balance 324,014.12. The expenses figure appears on BOTH pages and agrees, which is what joins them. WHAT THIS IS NOT: PAC's money is not in the General Fund appropriations schedule on pages 30-34 and must never be added to it. These are the accounts of a separate corporation funded from cable licence fees, and nothing on either page says which fund holds the balance or who may spend it. `New Equip` is printed as `$0` without cents, as the page prints it.

rows.proof: FY2018 annual town report page 154 -- the FY 2019 Capital Plan as it appears in the Annual Town Meeting warrant (Article 6), 11 projects against a printed `Total $520,214`, and above it the nine FY19 revolving fund SPENDING LIMITS voted under Article 3. Read off the page's OWN TEXT LAYER with pdfplumber, so the characters are exact. TWO INDEPENDENT IDENTITIES CLOSE: the 11 `Cost` figures sum to 520,214 exactly, and the page's second money column, `Cumulative Cost`, is the RUNNING SUM of the first and agrees at all eleven of its printed values (112,000 / 132,000 / 143,600 / 161,600 / 176,600 / 206,600 / 336,600 / 381,907 / 446,907 / 474,907 / 520,214), which is eleven assertions rather than one and cannot survive a single wrong digit anywhere in the column. The cumulative figures are recorded as `line` rows so they are not summed twice. THE NINE REVOLVING FUND LIMITS PRINT NO TOTAL ANYWHERE on the page and are recorded as `line` rows for the same reason: nothing on this page asserts their sum, so claiming one would be our arithmetic and not the town's. The project code `DPW17-o5B` is printed with a lower-case letter o where `DPW17-05A` above it prints a zero; transcribed as printed. `CPC recommends short term (5 year) financing option for Ladder Truck ($935,000) and other available funds` is prose beneath the table and its $935,000 is NOT a line of it.

rows.proof: The FY 2019 Omnibus Budget as voted at the 5 May 2018 Annual Town Meeting, pages 155-158 of the FY2018 annual town report -- 92 numbered line items (1 to 82, with letter suffixes, no gap in the numbering), 6 subtotals and 12 section totals under a printed Total Omnibus $36,804,408.83. Read off the pages' OWN TEXT LAYER with pdfplumber, so the characters are exact and no digit here can have been misread; the only open question is the document's own arithmetic. TEN OF THE TWELVE SECTION TOTALS FOOT THEIR OWN LINE ITEMS TO THE CENT, all six subtotals foot exactly, and Total Protection foots its four subtotals exactly. TWO COLUMNS ARE CHECKED AGAINST THE SAME PRINTED Total Omnibus AND BOTH ARE ATTESTED, in opposite directions, each isolating ONE misprint: the 92 line items sum to 36,803,699.83, exactly 709.00 short, which is the whole of the Total General Government over-print (22 lines sum to 1,400,410.25 against a printed 1,401,119.25); and the 12 section totals sum to 36,802,408.83, exactly 2,000.00 short, which is the whole of the Total Assistance under-print (Subtotal C.O.A. 139,718.56 + Subtotal Veterans 105,775.00 = 245,493.56 against a printed 243,493.56). Total Omnibus agrees with the CORRECTED Assistance figure to the cent, so the 2,000.00 did not propagate and the town's own grand total places the error in the printed Total Assistance line. Neither residual can be a reading error: a wrong digit anywhere else would break one of the ten footing sections or the Protection identity. PAGE 158 WAS NOT IN THE PAGE TRACKER -- it carries lines 76 to 82, Total Assistance, Total Schools, Total Library and the Total Omnibus itself, so the table cannot be proved without it. Line 58 prints `$ 1, 000.00` with a space inside the thousands group in the text layer itself; read as 1,000.00, which is what Total Health & Sanitation 73,838.58 requires.

rows.reconciliation: 6 full pages carry 94 rows, the last carries 22; fund_number runs in order through all 586 rows
rows.proof: COVERAGE, NOT ARITHMETIC: `Town & School Employee Calendar 2018 Gross Wages`, pages 248 to 254 of the FY2018 annual town report, prints 586 names and NO TOTAL ANYWHERE, so there is no arithmetic on the page to close and the check is the shape the page asserts about itself. Read off the pages' OWN TEXT LAYER with pdfplumber, so the characters are exact and no recognition was used. Every page but the last prints TWO columns of 47 names -- 94 a page across pages 248 to 253 -- and page 254 is a single column of 22. The run is ONE alphabetical sequence read DOWN THE LEFT COLUMN AND THEN DOWN THE RIGHT, page by page, and it does not go backwards once in 586 names: ABLAZA to BIENVENU then BIERY to CAPONETTE, CARDONE to CULLINANE then DACOSTA to FINCH, FINCH to HARRINGTON then HAUSLER to LANDI, LANDRY to MANSFIELD then MARABELLO to MILLETT, MITCHELL to PELKEY then PELLERIN to ROBUCCIO, RODER to SODANO then SPADAFINO to WARDWELL, and WARREN to ZRATE. Read line by line across both columns the list is in no order at all, which is why the columns are emitted separately. THREE NAMES WRAP ON A HYPHEN and print their first half ALONE on the line above, at the x of the column they belong to: `MCCARTHY-` + `GUILLETTE PATRICIA` on p251, and `PETERSON-` + `BLANKENSHIP NATHANIEL` and `KIMBERLY-` + `MONSINI ANNE` on p252 -- the last of those wraps the GIVEN name, not the surname, so the entry is MONSINI KIMBERLY-ANNE. Read without joining them the sequence goes backwards exactly twice, at GUILLETTE and at BLANKENSHIP, and those two breaks were a statement about the READER rather than about the town; joined, it never goes backwards. BOTH CHECKS OR NEITHER IS WORTH MUCH: the sequence catches a page or a block dropped and cannot see one name skipped; the count of 94 catches a skipped name and cannot see a dropped page. NEITHER CAN SEE A WRONG DIGIT -- a coverage check proves the SHAPE, not the figures -- and nothing in this archive prints these wages a second time, so there is nothing to reconcile them against. THREE OF THE SEVEN PAGES WERE NOT IN THE PAGE TRACKER AT ALL: 250, 251 and 252, each carrying a full 94 names. A page enters the tracker on fifteen recognised money figures and recognition did not reach them. `fund_number` is the FIRST printed token and is what the sequence is checked on; `fund_name` carries the rest verbatim. TEN ENTRIES PRINT THREE TOKENS and the page prints no comma, so nothing on it separates a two-word SURNAME from a two-word GIVEN NAME -- `WASSO PUKAITE ALEXIS` and `ST JEAN MARC` look exactly like `JOHNSON LEIGH ANN` and `CALMES LOXI JO`. The split is not made, because making it would be our claim and not the document's. Two different people are printed as `BRODEN JAMES`, at 1,500.00 and 6,569.70; they are kept as two rows because the page prints two.
